theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_pc_unitOrientation_comp
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ (α.compContinuousLinearMap L)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α * ‖L‖ ^ n) ∧ ((∀ v ∈ Q, L v = v) → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ (α.compContinuousLinearMap L) = ξ α)
